title: Meadow Awakening
summary: The expedition finds its footing and clears the meadow's edge.

title: Icefield Reckoning
summary: With the meadow open, the expedition pushes north onto the Stoneguard's frozen shelf.

title: Embervale Outskirts
summary: Embervale's militia holds its walls, and the wilds aren't the only thing pressing on them.

title: Norhollow Outskirts
summary: Norhollow holds its palisade line by the tally, and the mail keeps arriving already read.

title: The War Comes Home
summary: War is declared, the roads fill with people who left everything behind, and the crossroads at Millcross has to hold them.
